ValidationRule.description: ALF-RS-08 FR10, QA fix (Defect #4): caps deposit at vehicle price. Uses AF_VehiclePriceTotal__c when priced; falls back to Vehicle.MarketPrice when no price total exists yet.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: OR( AND( NOT(ISBLANK(AF_VehiclePriceTotal__c)), AF_VehiclePriceTotal__c > 0, NOT(ISBLANK(AF_DepositAmount__c)), AF_DepositAmount__c > AF_VehiclePriceTotal__c ), AND( ISBLANK(AF_VehiclePriceTotal__c), NOT(ISBLANK(AF_Vehicle__r.MarketPrice)), AF_Vehicle__r.MarketPrice > 0, NOT(ISBLANK(AF_DepositAmount__c)), AF_DepositAmount__c > AF_Vehicle__r.MarketPrice ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Deposit cannot exceed the vehicle price plus add-ons. Reduce the deposit or update the Vehicle Price + Add-Ons figure.
